yaml:
id: standard
name: Standard feature
stages:
  - id: spec
    name: Spec
    kind: user
    status: In progress
    session: true
    prompt: |
      Let's write the spec for {task} ({jira}). Ask me questions until it is clear. Do not change any code.
  - id: impl
    name: Implement
    kind: agent
    status: In progress
    steps:
      - id: plan
        name: Plan from spec
        runs_on: once
        before: auto
        on_failure: stop
        timeout: 20m
        prompt: |
          Read the task spec and the Jira ticket {jira}. Write an implementation plan per repo. Do not change code yet.
      - id: impl
        name: Implement
        runs_on: each repo
        before: auto
        on_failure: retry 1
        timeout: 2h
        prompt: |
          Implement the plan for {repo} on {branch} in {worktree}. Commit in small steps.
      - id: tests
        name: Write tests
        runs_on: each repo
        before: auto
        on_failure: "back:impl"
        timeout: 1h
        prompt: |
          Add or update tests for the changes on {branch}. If they fail because of the implementation, report what fails.
      - id: ci
        name: Make CI green
        runs_on: each repo
        before: auto
        on_failure: "back:impl"
        timeout: 1h
        prompt: |
          Run the checks for {branch}. Fix failures until they pass.
      - id: pr
        name: Open PRs
        runs_on: each repo
        before: approval
        on_failure: stop
        timeout: 15m
        prompt: |
          Open a draft PR for {branch} and link {jira}.
  - id: review
    name: Review
    kind: user
    status: In review
    session: true
    prompt: |
      Help me go through the review comments on {branch} and address them.
  - id: release
    name: Release
    kind: script
    status: In review
    runs_on: each repo
    on_failure: stop
    timeout: 15m
    command: |
      ./scripts/release.sh --branch {branch}
